# Bootstrap Checklist

- Read shared rules first.
- Detect whether the project is Next.js, Flutter, or generic.
- Inventory top-level folders and key config files.
- Extract package/pubspec metadata when available.
- Update managed blocks.
- Generate missing-context questions.
- Persist non-inferable answers in `.ai/project/context-decisions.json`.
- Rerun bootstrap after answers and verify freshness.
- Ask only unresolved questions.
